correctness.rationale: For each designated r-subset forming one whole functional component, every other image must remain in its complement; conditional on this event the complementary restriction is an independent uniform mapping. This proves E[K X_r]=E[X_r](1+mu_{n-r}); counting cycles proves mu_n. The rooted-forest/cycle decomposition yields c_r=(r-1)! sum_{q=0}^{r-1}r^q/q!, including r=n with 0^0=1. The function 1+mu_{n-r}-mu_n strictly decreases with r, has positive first and negative final term. The analytic Gaussian-product expansion mu_m=S_m+A/sqrt(m)+O(m^-1), A=sqrt(pi/2)/3, and the smooth Riemann-sum difference S_n-S_m=(1/2)log(n/m)+O(1/n), uniform for m/n in compact subsets (0,1), give the claimed cutoff shift. Independent enumeration of maps for n=2..5 and larger-n cutoff checks corroborated these identities; they do not prove the asymptotic.
